decisions.reason: Mobile PDF signing directly supports the firm's move toward online contract signing and sits close to the core offer, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some risk.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture underpins the integrated security platform and is likely folded into the core messaging rather than discontinued.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche feature that has not appeared on the website since 2018, so its resources are better spent on the core identity and communication platform.
Payment security compliance remains valuable to regulated banking customers and uses existing expertise, despite reduced visibility on the website.
